a body naming serverQuestionId is grounded in that server-issued practice question, read from the practice-question escrow keyed by (account_id, id): another account's id, an expired id and an unknown id are the same 404 TUTOR_QUESTION_NOT_FOUND before the cache, the allowance or the provider; such a body may not carry question (400); the Step Check is re-run on the server and, until the question is resolved, the answer is never excused and level walkthrough is 409 TUTOR_LEVEL_ORDER. A device question (no serverQuestionId) is stateless per account. Ladder replies (nudge/socratic/walkthrough) cached by a SHA-256 of the request content only (no account id), so an account can read back only a reply to an identical request; a conversational turn (level ask: free-text message ≤600 chars, control characters stripped, last 6 history turns server-trimmed) is cached under a key that also takes a truncated hash of the account, so free text is never read back by another account. 404 unless PRI_FEATURE_TUTOR=1; practice context only (TUTOR_EXAM_LOCKED); closed body ≤48 kB, maths-only (TUTOR_NOT_MATHS); per-account daily allowance (PRI_TUTOR_CALLS_PER_ACCOUNT_DAY, plan-aware) and one unit of the deployment paid-call ceiling per model call

same account-scoped serverQuestionId grounding as /v1/tutor/help (another account's issued question is 404 TUTOR_QUESTION_NOT_FOUND as JSON before any event); otherwise stateless per account; same body contract, exam lock, maths-only and size bounds as /v1/tutor/help, for levels nudge, socratic and ask only (walkthrough captions stay on /help). Every refusal — 404 dark, TUTOR_EXAM_LOCKED, body, TUTOR_NOT_CONFIGURED, TUTOR_DAILY_LIMIT (429), PAID_CAPACITY_REACHED — is answered as JSON before any event-stream byte and before the provider is contacted. The reply streams as text/event-stream (meta, delta, done | fallback | error); each sentence is checked against the verified solution before release and a leak ends the stream with the authored hint, uncached. Cache keyed as /help (per-account for ask). One open stream per session: a newer stream closes the older with TUTOR_STREAM_SUPERSEDED. Provider output capped per turn (STREAM_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, MAX_STREAM_CHARS).
